imageNote: Below this course's usual 3-screenshot floor, documented honestly rather than padded. docs.docker.com's Compose manual and compose-file reference were checked and confirmed to carry no embedded screenshots (same text-only pattern as Lessons 1-2). Five separate docker.com/blog posts specifically about Docker Compose were also checked for a real screenshot of Docker Desktop's Compose-specific stack/project grouping in the Containers view (where services sharing a compose.yaml's top-level `name` nest under one collapsible entry) — none of the posts checked embedded one; their images were author headshots, code-syntax renders, or conceptual filesystem-sync diagrams, not product UI. Rather than caption a diagram as a screenshot it isn't, this lesson uses two already-verified real Docker Desktop screenshots from Lesson 1, captioned specifically for what they do show (that a Compose-started container is an ordinary container in the same views), and will be revisited if docs.docker.com or docker.com publishes a genuine Compose-grouping screenshot later.
